reasoning: On the season so far the Hawks are the stronger team; with home court the Hawks start about 6 points better, in a game of about 247 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Bulls.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Hawks win 64 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 220 and 269 total points.

analyst.text: Chicago have lost eight straight, are 0-4 at home, and blew a 22-point lead to San Antonio on Wednesday. They also lost No. 4 pick Caleb Wilson to a hand injury, though Norman Powell is expected back from back spasms. Atlanta had three days to reset after the Lakers ended their four-game win streak, and this NBA Cup game opens a three-game trip. The mental lean is toward Atlanta; a Bulls team that keeps blowing leads is fragile late in games.
